text:
maria_sales: Quick sync — ACME wants a lift-and-shift from CompetitorX. They asked for a POC to validate parity, pricing delta, and answers to their security questionnaire. @ajay_se can you lead the technical POC?

ajay_se: Yep, I can take point. First questions: can they share a sample request/response + which endpoints they actually call in production? traffic profile (rps, avg toks) would help too.

luca_acme: We can share sample logs and a small corpus. They primarily call /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Avg is ~200 rps peak, 30k tok/day baseline. I'll DM the artifacts.

sam_support: I can provision staging keys + a test org. Will need an IP allowlist for their smoke tests.

jenna_security: Heads up from security side: they requested SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, and network egress details. We need their completed questionnaire + any specific data residency requirements. If they send SSP/arch diagram we can usually turn around in ~48h. Link to our questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec/questionnaire (internal).

kevin_product: For model mapping: CompetitorX main endpoints map roughly to our redwood-alpha (text-gen) and chat-rt (chat). We'll run prompt-parity evals; expect small delta in edge cases. Recommend we include a short regression eval set from ACME to measure.

ajay_se: Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Week 0: onboarding + keys + IP allowlist.
2) Week 1: request/response mapping, smoke tests against staging (500 req/day synthetic), quick quality eval on customer prompts.
3) Week 2: perf tuning (batching, kv cache), ramp to 2k rps if needed, collect logs + quality report.
Pricing ask from customer: they want committed vs pay-as-you-go options. Maria, what discount bands do we have for 6mo/12mo commits?

maria_sales: Ballpark: hosted commit discounts generally 25% for 6mo, 35% for 12mo depending on volume. Dedicated/reserved capacity can be structured too — will confirm with finance. I'll prepare a draft SOW + pricing breakdown.

luca_acme: Procurement timeline: we'd like a draft SOW by Friday. Security wants to kick the questionnaire this week. Legal will need IP & data handling language.

jenna_security: We can do the questionnaire this week if they provide SSP + diagram. Please have them email security@redwood.com and cc the sales thread.

ajay_se: Quick mapping note — competitor uses this simple JSON request body:
```
POST https://api.competitorx.com/v1/generate
{
  "prompt": "Translate to FR: Hello",
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```
Equivalent call in our API (quick example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"Translate to FR: Hello","max_tokens":200}'
```
I'll include this in the POC doc so their engineers can do a smoke run.

deploy-bot: staging keys created for thread 1718492024: rwd-staging-v2-1718492024 (expires in 7 days).

sam_support: Provisioning note: I'll open a dedicated test VPC and add an nginx ingress with TLS. Public IP -> 10.0.5.12. Sharing conn details via DM after setup.

kevin_product: Product flag: implement fallback policy for parity. Recommendation: on overload, route to quantized 8-bit variant to preserve latency; record a sample of diffs for SLO. Also include prompt normalization mapping in POC to reduce response variance.

maria_sales: Next steps agreed: Ajay to push a 1-page POC plan + mapping doc by EOD tomorrow, Jenna to confirm security turnaround, Sam to spin up infra, and I'll draft SOW/pricing. Scheduling: 30-min sync Fri 10:00am PT. Luca — can you confirm procurement & security contacts? :calendar:

luca_acme: Confirmed — procurement is sara.procure@acme.com, security is mike.sec@acme.com. They'll expect the questionnaire by Thursday.

maria_sales: Thanks — tagging action owners: @ajay_se, @jenna_security, @sam_support. I'll follow up with the calendar invite and SOW stub. :thumbsup:

ajay_se: I'll upload the POC doc to this thread and ping when ready.

jenna_security: If anyone needs templates (NDA/SLA/SOW), use the templates in drive: /security/templates/enterprise-templates.

maria_sales: Great — closing loop. We'll reconvene after Ajay posts the doc.

(reacts: :rocket:, :eyes:)
